notes.title: Full controller support update!
notes.content:
The default key-mapping is set to [b]Xbox 360 Controller[/b].
[img]http://blog-imgs-86.fc2.com/h/u/u/huumaminathegame/Readme_Joystick_ENG_360p.png[/img]

If you're using difference joystick / gamepad, please redefine your key-mappings on Configuration Dialog.

[img]http://blog-imgs-86.fc2.com/h/u/u/huumaminathegame/CE_Joystick_KeyMapping_Manual.png[/img]

1. switch to "Input" page.
2. double click to define your [b]Kick[/b] and [b]Jump[/b] buttons.
3. double click to define your [b]Horizontal[/b] and [b]Vertical[/b] Axis by using [b]Left Analog Stick[/b].
4. double click to define your [b]Submit[/b] and [b]Cancel[/b] buttons. We recommend that you use the same button with [b]Jump[/b] for [b]Submit[/b] button.
5. double click to define your [b]Camera Rotation Axis[/b] by using [b]Right Analog Stick[/b].
6. double click to define your [b]ZoomIn[/b] and [b]ZoomOut[/b] buttons.
7. double click to define your D-pad axis, some joysticks report no D-pad axis. Please use other analog axis here. Please don't worry about incorrect D-pad settings, we'll also use the the axis you defined in step 3 to simulate D-pad.
8. double click to define your [b]SwitchFarCam[/b] and [b]ResetCamera[/b] buttons.
9. double click to define your [b]Struggle[/b] and [b]Skip[/b] buttons.

Finally, you can adjust Camera Rotation Option in Game's Option Panel, if the default behavior does not meet your need.

[img]http://blog-imgs-86.fc2.com/h/u/u/huumaminathegame/CE_CameraSettingsInGame.png[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: Thanks, Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
First of all, I want to say thank you to all of you.
Thank you for buying and playing!
Thank you for the review! 
Thank you for suggestions or bug-reports.
Thank you for making Youtube video.
Thank you for friend invitations!

This is my first game on Steam and I keep learning things here.
I'm glad you're here to help me learn more about it. I'll try my best next time
If there is a "next time" :D

Honestly, I don't have enough money to keep on developing or improving this game. All that I can do is fixing bugs and making costumes. Sorry for that and I'll try Patreon later. Thank you very much!

1. Fixed the bug that a falling character has a great chance to touch the exit and clear the stage.
2. New Accessory added: "[b]Santa Hat[/b]"
3. New Costume added: "[b]Santa Costume[/b]"
4. Fixed some material problems on Mac.
5. Fixed [b]Steam Achievement[/b] problems.

Maybe it's a little bit early, but I wish you a 
Merry X'mas and Happy New Year.
